name: VIDENTIA company identity benchmark v1
source: Curated from observed INAPI/company-identity variants plus conservative legal-form controls.
policy: A true match means safe enough for deterministic canonical normalization. Corporate group, subsidiary, person-name and brand-substring similarity are not auto-link evidence.

cases.reason: Observed aliases on the same resolved Falabella identity.
Country prefix and punctuation must not split identity.

Group/operating-company relationship is not identity equivalence.
